_comment: The workshop's name sign on the north wall (WorkshopSign.cs). Everything a designer can tune lives here; the game reads this file at start-up, so edits need no rebuild of the code (a fresh build or a copy of this file next to the build is enough). Distances in metres, colours [r, g, b] 0..1. Positions on the artwork are in artwork pixels (x from the left, y from the top) of resources/Workshop Wreckage Sign.png, so they stay correct whatever the sign's size on the wall.

artwork._comment: The picture on the sign. To change it: replace resources/Workshop Wreckage Sign.png (black background, any size) and run  python tools/sign/make_sign_art.py --debug layers.png  which writes the cut-out texture (Resources/SignArt.png) and the sign split into depth layers (Resources/SignShape.txt: housing, recessed panel, letters, decoration); check layers.png, then re-measure the lamp and chain pixels below.

placement._comment: width_m: the artwork's width on the wall (height follows the picture's proportions; 5.25 = 1.25x the first version, the largest that clears the pipes above and the bench blueprints below). offset_up_m: the sign's centre above the wall fixture's centre (3.7 m up the north wall).

depth._comment: How far each layer of the artwork stands out, in metres from the back of the steel housing. back_from_wall_m: the gap between the housing and the wall (shadow line). housing_m: the box's depth (its front is the painted frame). panel_m: the dark backing, recessed into the housing. letters_m: the letters and gear O's, each moved out (+) or in (-) by its letter_offsets_m entry (W O R K S H O P, then W R E C K A G E) so they look bolted on one by one, not stamped out; keep letters_m + offset above housing_m. decoration_m: pipes and ornaments round the housing. side_shade: brightness of the letters' side walls (the paint, darker) 0..1.

contact_shadow._comment: A static dark shadow baked into the artwork (Resources/SignArt.png) on the panel and frame round each letter, so the letters stand off the backing without a real-time shadow. Costs nothing in the game: it is paint. Read by make_sign_art.py, so after a change re-run  python tools/sign/make_sign_art.py  and rebuild. strength: how dark right at a letter's edge, 0..1. drop / side: how far the shadow falls down / to the right, as a fraction of the letter's height off the panel (the light is above and in front). blur_px / blur_per_m: softness in artwork pixels, plus more for letters standing further out. halo: share of the shadow that also hugs the letter all round (contact darkening).

housing._comment: The steel box. side_color / side_chips: its rusty side panels (paint colour, how much is chipped). hardware_color: seams, straps, lugs and bolts. Bolts sit every bolt_spacing_m along the exposed top and bottom.

chains._comment: Two real chains from lugs on the housing's top to eye plates on the wall (the chains painted in the artwork are cut away by make_sign_art.py). x_px: where each lug sits (artwork pixels). rise_m: how far above the housing's top the wall eyes are (kept below the wall pipes).

lamps._comment: The O in WORKSHOP: the brighter bulb, but a bad one: it flickers now and then.
The O in SHOP: a slightly weaker, warmer bulb, steady.

lamp_look._comment: Shared by both lamps, each scaled by its strength. glass_radius_px: the glass dome over the painted bulb (artwork pixels, so it follows the sign's size). glass_glow / core_glow: how hot the dome's edge and centre burn (emission; higher clips to white in the bloom). light_*: the real light each lamp throws into the room, distance_out_m in front of the letters.

flicker._comment: The flickering lamp. Each pair is a random range [min, max]. A flicker burst comes every every_s seconds and lasts burst_s; inside it the bulb jumps to a new level every step_s, either fully on (full_on_chance) or dimmed to dim_level. drift: a slow wobble in each old lamp's brightness, independent per lamp (0.12 = ±6 %). Lamps stay steady in tests and screenshots.

spotlight._comment: A warm spot from above that models the letters (they cast soft shadows onto the recessed panel when shadows is true) and keeps the name readable. Placed above_m over the housing's top and out_m in front of the wall, aimed at aim_down_m below the sign's centre.

ceiling_fixture._comment: The fluorescent ceiling fixture that hung just in front of the sign hid its top from the floor and washed out its face: a fixture within within_m in front of the sign moves move_m further into the room.
